subject: v-sy
title: V.SY.------POL.DY.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-40 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's analysis of media as the gatekeeper of alternative considerations: 'as long as western culture can give the illusion that western information principles are valid when applied to any offering from the world group aesthetic, this practice will continue.' V-SY (the value system) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what value-system produces when crossed with political-dynamics, where political-dynamics is the gatekeeping function executed by media. INFO-INTR (information interpretation) branches from the main line and carries MOT-DY. DY-F (dynamic functionalism) also branches from the main line and carries RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and POL-P (political policies), which leads to PART (participation) and on to RT-OP (reality options).
